text: 经国务院批复同意，国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局、国家发展改革委、财政部、农业农村部、海关总署、国家中医药局等7部门联合印发《疾病预防控制“十五五”规划》。《规划》提出，要动态优化国家免疫规划疫苗种类，推动将疾病负担重、成本效益高、财政可负担、国际有共识的疫苗纳入国家免疫规划。面向中老年人、妇女等重点人群，推广疾病负担重、接种效果好的疫苗接种，逐步实现全生命周期全人群免疫和预防接种。推动二级及以上医疗机构提供预防接种服务，全面推广电子预防接种证和预防接种数据跨地区共享，为人民群众提供更加公平、可及、便捷的预防接种服务。
text_en: With approval from the State Council, the National Health Commission, National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, General Administration of Customs, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine jointly issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Disease Prevention and Control.' The plan proposes dynamically optimizing the types of vaccines in the National Immunization Program, promoting the inclusion of vaccines with high disease burden, good cost-effectiveness, fiscal affordability, and international consensus. For key populations such as middle-aged and elderly people and women, it promotes vaccination against diseases with high burden and good efficacy, gradually achieving full-lifecycle immunization and vaccination for all people. It also pushes for secondary and above medical institutions to provide vaccination services, fully promoting electronic vaccination certificates and cross-regional data sharing to provide fairer, more accessible, and convenient vaccination services.
